verdict.rationale: Jules publishes first-party API documentation at developers.google.com/jules/api. The docs cover creating API keys in Settings, creating sessions with an optional automationMode for automatic PRs, sending messages to the agent, and approving plans programmatically. They also describe building custom workflows and Slack/Linear/GitHub integrations. A community user independently confirms driving Jules through the API by wrapping it in a personal MCP server. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths 404), and thin evidence on the full endpoint surface and on API stability or versioning.
